name: google-calendar
label: Google Calendar
description: Get organized and stay on schedule

google-calendar-add-attendees.label: Add Attendees to Event
google-calendar-add-attendees.description: Adds guests to an existing event.

eventId.label: Event ID
eventId.description: Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

attendees.label: Attendees
attendees.description: One guest email per item. A JSON list, such as ["ada@example.com"].

create_quick_event.label: Create Quick Event
create_quick_event.description: Creates an event from a plain-language phrase.

send_updates.label: Send Updates
send_updates.description: Who gets an email invitation for the new event.

create_google_calendar_event.label: Create Event
create_google_calendar_event.description: Creates an event with a title, time, guests and options.

end_date_time.label: End Time
end_date_time.description: Defaults to 30 minutes after the start.

colorId.label: Color
colorId.description: Leave empty for the calendar default.

attendees.label: Attendees
attendees.description: One guest email per item. A JSON list, such as ["ada@example.com"].

send_notifications.label: Send Notifications
send_notifications.description: Who gets an email invitation for the new event.

create_meet_link.label: Create Google Meet Link
create_meet_link.description: Adds a Google Meet link to the event.

google_calendar_get_events.label: Get Events
google_calendar_get_events.description: Lists events in a calendar, with optional filters.

event_types.label: Event Types
event_types.description: Only events of these types are returned. A JSON list of "default", "outOfOffice", "focusTime", "workingLocation".

search.label: Search Term
search.description: Exact phrase matched against title, description, location and guests.

start_date.label: Start Time
start_date.description: Only events that end after this time.

end_date.label: End Time
end_date.description: Only events starting before this. Requires Start Time.

singleEvents.label: Expand Recurring Events
singleEvents.description: Returns each occurrence of a recurring event separately.

update_event.label: Update Event
update_event.description: Updates an existing event; empty fields keep their value.

eventId.label: Event ID
eventId.description: Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

attendees.label: Attendees
attendees.description: Replaces the current guest list. One email per item. A JSON list, such as ["ada@example.com"].

delete_event.label: Delete Event
delete_event.description: Deletes an event from Google Calendar.

eventId.label: Event ID
eventId.description: Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

google_calendar_find_busy_free_periods.label: Find Busy/Free Periods in Calendar
google_calendar_find_busy_free_periods.description: Finds busy periods across calendars in a time range.

calendar_ids.label: Calendars
calendar_ids.description: Calendars to check. A JSON list of calendar IDs, such as ["primary"].

start_date.label: Start Time
start_date.description: The start of the time range to check.

end_date.label: End Time
end_date.description: The end of the time range to check.

google_calendar_get_event_by_id.label: Get Event by ID
google_calendar_get_event_by_id.description: Fetch event details by its unique ID from Google Calendar.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

max_attendees.label: Max Attendees
max_attendees.description: Above this count, only you are returned.

time_zone.label: Time Zone
time_zone.description: IANA name, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to the calendar zone.

google_calendar_search_events_all_calend.label: Search Events Across Calendars
google_calendar_search_events_all_calend.description: Searches every calendar the account can access for events matching a keyword within a required time window.

query.label: Search Term
query.description: Free-text query matched against event fields (summary, description, location, attendee names/emails) using Google's native search. Example: "budget review".

start_date.label: Start Time
start_date.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for an event's end time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"). Required to bound the cross-calendar scan.

end_date.label: End Time
end_date.description: Upper bound (exclusive) for an event's start time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z"). Required to bound the cross-calendar scan.

single_events.label: Expand Recurring Events?
single_events.description: When enabled, recurring events are expanded into their individual instances instead of returning the underlying recurring event.

google_calendar_find_free_slots.label: Find Free Time Slots
google_calendar_find_free_slots.description: Computes open time slots shared across one or more calendars within a window, by inverting their busy blocks.

calendar_ids.label: Calendars
calendar_ids.description: The calendars whose schedules must all be free. A slot is returned only when it is open on every selected calendar. A JSON list of calendar IDs, such as ["primary"].

start_date.label: Window Start
start_date.description: Start of the search window, as an absolute ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-01T09:00:00Z"). Prefer absolute times over relative ones.

end_date.label: Window End
end_date.description: End of the search window, as an absolute ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-05T18:00:00Z").

min_duration_minutes.label: Minimum Slot Duration (minutes)
min_duration_minutes.description: Discard any open slot shorter than this many minutes. Leave empty to return every open slot regardless of length.

working_hours_start.label: Working Hours Start (hour 0-23)
working_hours_start.description: If set together with Working Hours End, each day's open slots are clipped to this hour range, interpreted in UTC (not the calendar's local time zone). Example: 9 for 09:00 UTC. Leave both unset to return slots across the full window.

working_hours_end.label: Working Hours End (hour 0-23)
working_hours_end.description: Upper bound of the daily working-hours window. Example: 17 for 5 PM. Ignored unless Working Hours Start is also set.

google_calendar_list_recurring_event_ins.label: List Recurring Event Instances
google_calendar_list_recurring_event_ins.description: Lists the individual occurrences of one recurring event series, each with its own instance event ID.

event_id.label: Recurring Event ID
event_id.description: The event ID of the recurring SERIES (the parent), e.g. "abc123def456". Obtain it from Search Events Across Calendars or Get all Events. Individual instance IDs will not work here.

time_min.label: Start Time
time_min.description: Optional lower bound (inclusive) for an instance's end time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp with offset (e.g. "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z").

time_max.label: End Time
time_max.description: Optional upper bound (exclusive) for an instance's start time, as an ISO 8601 timestamp with offset (e.g. "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z").

show_deleted.label: Include Cancelled Instances
show_deleted.description: Whether to include cancelled (deleted) instances of the series in the result. Defaults to false.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of instances to return per page (1-2500). Defaults to the API default of 250.

google_calendar_list_recurring_event_ins.afterResponse: return {instances: response.items ?? [], count: (response.items ?? []).length, nextPageToken: response.nextPageToken ?? null};

google_calendar_move_event.label: Move Event to Another Calendar
google_calendar_move_event.description: Moves an existing event from one calendar to another, preserving its event ID and metadata.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: The ID of the event to move, e.g. "abc123def456". Obtain it from Search Events Across Calendars or Get all Events.

destination_calendar_id.label: Destination Calendar
destination_calendar_id.description: The calendar to move the event to.

send_updates.label: Send Notifications
send_updates.description: Who should receive notifications about the change of the event's organizer.

google_calendar_create_event.label: Create Event
google_calendar_create_event.description: Create a new event on a Google Calendar with structured fields (title, start/end, location, description, attendees, color) and an optional Google Meet link.

end_date_time.label: End Time
end_date_time.description: Defaults to 30 minutes after the start.

colorId.label: Color
colorId.description: Leave empty for the calendar default.

attendees.label: Attendees
attendees.description: One guest email per item. A JSON list, such as ["ada@example.com"].

send_notifications.label: Send Notifications
send_notifications.description: Who gets an email invitation for the new event.

create_meet_link.label: Create Google Meet Link
create_meet_link.description: Adds a Google Meet link to the event.

google_calendar_update_event.label: Update Event
google_calendar_update_event.description: Update fields of an existing Google Calendar event by ID using a safe get-then-merge; fields you leave unset keep their current values.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: The ID of the event to update. Resolve it via List Events or Search Events Across Calendars.

attendees.label: Attendees
attendees.description: Replaces the current guest list. One email per item. A JSON list, such as ["ada@example.com"].

guests_can_modify.label: Guests can modify
guests_can_modify.description: Leave unset to keep the event's current value.

guests_can_invite_others.label: Guests can invite others
guests_can_invite_others.description: Leave unset to keep the event's current value.

guests_can_see_other_guests.label: Guests can see other guests
guests_can_see_other_guests.description: Leave unset to keep the event's current value.

google_calendar_delete_event.label: Delete Event
google_calendar_delete_event.description: Permanently delete an event from a Google Calendar by its event ID.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: The ID of the event to delete. Resolve it via List Events or Search Events Across Calendars.

google_calendar_get_event.label: Get Event
google_calendar_get_event.description: Fetch the full details of a single Google Calendar event by its event ID.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

max_attendees.label: Max Attendees
max_attendees.description: Above this count, only you are returned.

time_zone.label: Time Zone
time_zone.description: IANA name, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to the calendar zone.

google_calendar_list_events.label: List Events
google_calendar_list_events.description: List events from one Google Calendar, optionally filtered by date range, free-text search, and event types.

event_types.label: Event Types
event_types.description: Only events of these types are returned. A JSON list of "default", "outOfOffice", "focusTime", "workingLocation".

search.label: Search Term
search.description: Exact phrase matched against title, description, location and guests.

start_date.label: Start Time
start_date.description: Only events that end after this time.

end_date.label: End Time
end_date.description: Only events starting before this. Requires Start Time.

singleEvents.label: Expand Recurring Events
singleEvents.description: Returns each occurrence of a recurring event separately.

google_calendar_find_busy_periods.label: Find Busy Periods
google_calendar_find_busy_periods.description: Return the raw busy time blocks of one or more calendars within a window, via the freebusy query.

calendar_ids.label: Calendars
calendar_ids.description: Calendars to check. A JSON list of calendar IDs, such as ["primary"].

start_date.label: Start Time
start_date.description: The start of the time range to check.

end_date.label: End Time
end_date.description: The end of the time range to check.

google_calendar_remove_attendee.label: Remove Attendee
google_calendar_remove_attendee.description: Remove one attendee (by email) from an existing Google Calendar event, preserving the rest of the guest list.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: The ID of the event to remove the attendee from. Resolve it via List Events or Search Events Across Calendars.

attendee_email.label: Attendee Email
attendee_email.description: Email address of the attendee to remove from the event.

send_updates.label: Send Notifications
send_updates.description: Who should be notified about the attendee change.

google_calendar_import_event.label: Import Event
google_calendar_import_event.description: Import an existing event (by iCalUID) into a Google Calendar as a private copy, using events.import.

ical_uid.label: iCal UID
ical_uid.description: The event's iCalUID (its globally unique identifier, e.g. "abc123@google.com"). This is the dedup key: re-importing the same UID updates the existing copy.

start_date_time.label: Start Time
start_date_time.description: Event start as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-01T09:00:00Z").

end_date_time.label: End Time
end_date_time.description: Event end as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-01T10:00:00Z").

description.label: Description
description.description: Description of the event. You can use HTML tags here.

google_calendar_list_calendars.label: List Calendars
google_calendar_list_calendars.description: List every calendar in the user's calendar list, returning each calendar's id, summary, access role, time zone, and whether it is primary.

google_calendar_get_calendar.label: Get Calendar
google_calendar_get_calendar.description: Fetch one calendar's metadata (summary, time zone, description, location) by its calendar ID.

google_calendar_get_colors.label: Get Colors
google_calendar_get_colors.description: Fetch the Google Calendar color palette mapping colorId values to their hex background/foreground colors.

google_calendar_list_settings.label: List Settings
google_calendar_list_settings.description: List the user's Google Calendar account settings (time zone, week start, date/time format, and more).
